title: Toxicity Detection is NOT all you Need: Measuring the Gaps to Supporting Volunteer Content Moderators through a User-Centric Method
reasoning: The paper evaluates models on their ability to detect violations of moderation rules, which include ethical standards like civility, harassment, bigotry, and political/moralizing agendas. It also references rules for the r/Atheism subreddit, including 'Proselytizing', which relates to religious content.
